plugins.name: shipping-pull-requests
plugins.description: Opens, reviews and merges the current branch's pull request on GitHub (gh CLI); the developer commits, the skill never does. Builds on the superpowers code-review skills and is adapted from a GitLab merge-request workflow. The project's root CLAUDE.md needs a "Shipping pull requests" section with the review checklist (the rule files the reviewer applies).
